rule: A textual motif can enter this watchlist without promotion. Promotion requires an exact source locator, a frozen modern operator, preregistered metrics, and a test showing strict improvement without correctness/certificate regression.

sources.source: Book of Two Ways / Coffin Texts
sources.why_high_priority: The corpus is explicitly route-like: mapped paths/watercourses, labelled regions and guided traversal. This is the closest textual analogue to PT477 route clearing without needing to invent a modern route metaphor.
sources.test_idea: derive an incremental route class from parent->child deltas and use it only to prevent horizon entry; charge update cost; compare collisions/escapes/canonicalization against the frozen BH-Q2 baseline

sources.why_high_priority: These chapters concern keepers/names of approaches and ordered gateways, naturally suggesting typed authorization before traversal rather than rescanning the whole residual.
sources.test_idea: candidate horizon entry must satisfy an incrementally maintained gate type; a mismatch rejects the route without canonicalization; exact Buzz remains the absorption authority

sources.source: Book of the Dead chapters 117-122 and 126
sources.why_high_priority: The sequence repeatedly combines reaching/receiving a way, entering/exiting, passing secret gates and removal of obstacles.
sources.test_idea: freeze a finite ordered set of cheap preconditions computed from existing state metadata; test whether early failure reduces event-horizon work while all accepted routes preserve exact reverse replay

sources.why_high_priority: The composition includes separation of ways, repelling/turning back an adversarial route, and repeated coming/going accounting associated with Thoth.
sources.test_idea: use as a specification pattern for separating candidate routes into safe-to-approach vs no-go from inherited metadata, while counting both forward and return obligations

sources.why_high_priority: The underworld journey is staged through ordered hours and culminates in transformation/rebirth, making it suitable as a state-machine inspiration rather than a one-shot filter.
sources.test_idea: only after the PT477 route-pruning problem is resolved, test whether explicit phase ownership prevents repeated work across search phases without changing Boolean terminals

sources.why_high_priority: Ordered passage through gates suggests fail-closed typed transition checks and may complement the Book of the Dead gate chapters.
sources.test_idea: freeze transition types and reject illegal phase transitions before expensive processing; no semantic oracle and no post-hoc gate definitions

Book_of_the_Living.policy: Do not mine it for instructions until a specific ancient Egyptian work/witness is identified. 'Book of the Dead' itself is a modern title for the ancient 'chapters for coming forth by day'; nearby legitimate corpora include Coffin Texts/Book of Two Ways, Amduat and Book of Gates.

next_action: Before coding PT477-v2, perform a source-level pass over Book of Two Ways and Book of the Dead 144-147, then preregister exactly one operator with frozen metrics. Do not batch-test multiple interpretations and select the winner.
claim_boundary: This watchlist records research inspiration only. No item is evidence that ancient Egyptians encoded modern algorithms or complexity results. P_VS_NP remains OPEN.
